mapper.select: SELECT * FROM CHAT_ROOM R WHERE ( (R.USER_A = #{userId} AND R.USER_B = #{otherId}) OR (R.USER_A = #{otherId} AND R.USER_B = #{userId}) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_ROOM_HIDE H WHERE H.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND H.USER_ID = #{userId} ) LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM CHAT_ROOM R WHERE ( (R.USER_A = #{userId} AND R.USER_B = #{otherId}) OR (R.USER_A = #{otherId} AND R.USER_B = #{userId}) ) LIMIT 1

SELECT R.ROOM_ID, CASE WHEN R.USER_A = #{userId} THEN R.USER_B ELSE R.USER_A END AS OTHER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS OTHER_NICK, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS OTHER_IMG,
( SELECT M.CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS LAST_MSG,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.SENDER_ID != #{userId} AND M.IS_READ = 'N' ) AS UNREAD_COUNT,
( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(M.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS LAST_AT
FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN USER U ON U.USER_ID = CASE WHEN R.USER_A = #{userId} THEN R.USER_B ELSE R.USER_A END
LEFT JOIN CHAT_ROOM_HIDE H ON H.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND H.USER_ID = #{userId}
WHERE (R.USER_A = #{userId} OR R.USER_B = #{userId}) AND ( H.ROOM_ID IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.SENDER_ID != #{userId} AND M.CREATED_AT > H.CREATED_AT ) )
ORDER BY LAST_AT DESC

mapper.select:
SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID, M.ROOM_ID, M.SENDER_ID,
CASE WHEN M.IS_DELETED = 'Y' THEN '삭제된 메시지입니다' ELSE M.CONTENT END AS CONTENT,
CASE WHEN M.IS_DELETED = 'Y' THEN 'TEXT' ELSE M.MESSAGE_TYPE END AS MESSAGE_TYPE,
M.IS_READ, M.IS_DELETED, DATE_FORMAT(M.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATED_AT, U.NICKNAME AS SENDER_NICK, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS SENDER_IMG
FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M JOIN USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.SENDER_ID
LEFT JOIN CHAT_ROOM_HIDE RH ON RH.ROOM_ID = M.ROOM_ID AND RH.USER_ID = #{userId}
WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND ( RH.ROOM_ID IS NULL OR M.CREATED_AT > RH.CREATED_AT ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_MESSAGE_HIDE H WHERE H.MESSAGE_ID = M.MESSAGE_ID AND H.USER_ID = #{userId} )
ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT ASC
